body:
## Summary

The WASM/TS boundary implements a **strict full-schema ingestion path with atomic apply and one undo group**, but it implements a *subset* of plan/12 §2–§5. The dominant gaps are:

1. **`ImportOptions` does not exist at all** — `source`, `idPolicy`, `idSeed`, `addToHistory`, `requestId`, `limits` are neither parsed nor modelled, and `ImportPayload` has no `deny_unknown_fields`, so an `options` object is **silently discarded** (violates §3.1/§4 "sem fallback silencioso").
2. **No ID policy / `idMap`**: only implicit "preserve"; `regenerate`/`reject` absent; duplicate IDs surface as an internal invariant code `I16` mapped to `invalid-wire`, not `duplicate_id`.
3. **Op vocabulary is a different vocabulary**: `insertTable`, `setMetadata`, `insertFragment`, `replaceRange` are absent; `replaceRange`/`insertFragment` are replaced by a non-plan `replace_fragment`.
4. **`FragmentJSON` is not the plan's token model**: only `blocks` is read (openStart/openEnd silently ignored), and blocks must be *DocJSON* (`type`/`content`/`marks`), not plan `BlockToken` (`kind`/`runs`/`atoms`/`children`).
5. **`ImportReport` shape diverges** (`accepted/blocks/version/problems/state` vs `ok/schema/acceptedBlocks/idMap/requestId`) and `import` never rejects with `ProblemDetails`.
6. **No `BatchLimits`**, no `missing_asset`/`unrepresentable_feature`, no `Origin::Import(source)`, no composition methods, no `block(index)`, no `view(range)`, no `Transaction` in WASM.

## Architecture (as wired)

- WASM `Editor` holds `CoreEditor` + `Arc<Schema>` from `Schema::full()` (`crates/rich-editor-auy-wasm/src/editor.rs:41-49, 59-62`).
- `apply`/`dryRun`/`import` all operate on a **clone** and commit only on success (`editor.rs:139-152`, `160-184`, `193-229`).
- `import` → `import::run_import` dispatches `document` / `fragment|replace|insert` / `ops` (`import.rs:15-51`); replacements go through one `replace_document` transaction with `Origin::Import` and `GroupId(version+1)` (`import.rs:73-83`); ops run through `stage::run_ops` with one shared `GroupId`, which `History::record` absorbs into a single undo group (`stage.rs:67-85`, `state/history.rs:154-166`).
- Token decoding reuses the document wire parser (`ops.rs:75-88` → `wire::parser`), so import accepts the canonical Doc JSON block grammar rather than plan tokens.
- DTOs are `serde` structs/enums with camelCase aliases only for op names (`dto.rs:68-190`); envelope structs have no unknown-field rejection.

## Requirement → status → evidence

### Plan 12 §2 — entry forms

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `ImportDocument{mode:"document", schema, doc, options?}` | Partial | `dto.rs:199-236` has `mode/schema/doc`; `options` absent. `import.rs:21-27`. TS `ImportDocumentPayload` `packages/ts/packages/core/mod.ts:237-241`. |
| `ImportFragment{mode:"replace"|"insert", schema, at/from/to, fragment, options?}` | Divergent | `import.rs:28-45` accepts `"fragment"` (extra) plus `replace`/`insert`; accepts optional `at` for `"fragment"` (`import.rs:58-63`). No `options`. TS union `mod.ts:243-250`. |
| `ImportOps{mode:"ops", schema, baseVersion, ops, options?}` | Partial | `dto.rs:224-236` has `base_version` (+`baseVersion` alias, `dto.rs:230-231`); required-ness not enforced; no `options`. |
| `BatchOp.replaceDocument` | Present | `dto.rs:148-152` (`replace_document`/`replaceDocument`); `stage.rs:157-164`. |
| `BatchOp.replaceRange{from,to,fragment}` | Divergent | No `replaceRange`; non-plan `replace_fragment` with `from/to/at` (`dto.rs:153-168`, `stage.rs:165-182`). |
| `BatchOp.insertFragment{at,fragment}` | Divergent | Only via `replace_fragment` with `at` and empty range (`stage.rs:174-176`). |
| `BatchOp.insertTable{at, table}` | **Missing** | No op in `dto.rs:68-190`; core `Editor::insert_table` exists (`state/table_commands.rs:29-73`) but is not in `Transaction` and not exposed in WASM (`wasm/rich_editor_auy_wasm.d.ts:1-118`). |
| `BatchOp.setDocAttr` | Present | `dto.rs:105-112`, `stage.rs:143-156`. |
| `BatchOp.setNodeAttr` | Partial/Divergent | Only block-level `set_block_attr` (aliases `setNodeAttr`/`set_node_attr`) resolves `block_kind_at` (`dto.rs:92-104`, `stage.rs:126-142`). No generic node addressing; atoms use separate `set_inline_attr`. |
| `BatchOp.setInlineAttr` | Present | `dto.rs:113-124`, `stage.rs:147-156` (requires request range be exactly one atom byte: `attr.rs:152-155`). |
| `BatchOp.setSelection` | Present | `dto.rs:176-179`, `stage.rs:183-185`. |
| `BatchOp.setMetadata{metadata}` | **Missing** | No `setMetadata` op; `metadata` is only reachable through `set_doc_attr("metadata", …)` (`schema/full/attrs.rs:19`, `stage.rs:143-156`). |
| Unknown op name rejected | Present | serde tagged enum (`dto.rs:68`); test `tests.rs:30-33`. |
| Unknown *fields* rejected | **Missing/Divergent** | `BatchPayload`/`ImportPayload`/`Op` have no `deny_unknown_fields` (`dto.rs:191-236`); serde silently ignores extras. dto module doc claims the opposite (`dto.rs:1-8`). |

### Plan 12 §3 — canonical tokens

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `FragmentJSON{blocks, openStart?, openEnd?}` | Partial | `wire/fragment.rs:29-64` reads only `blocks`; `openStart/openEnd` are never read → silently ignored by serde-less hand parser. TS declares only `blocks` (`mod.ts:202-204`). `Slice.open_start/open_end` exist in core (`step/mod.rs:38-41`) but are not wired. |
| `BlockToken{kind, id?, attrs?, runs?, atoms?, children?}` | **Missing (different vocabulary)** | Decoder requires `"type"` (`wire/parser.rs:151`, `wire/parser.rs:172-180`) and `"content"` (`parser.rs:151`); `wire/parser.rs:246-255` expects `text` runs with `marks`. Blocks carrying `kind/runs/atoms/children` fail with `missing_type`/`unknown_node`. |
| `RunToken{text, marks?}` / `MarkToken{type, attrs?}` / `AtomToken{kind, attrs?}` | Divergent | Only Doc-JSON inline nodes accepted (`wire/parser.rs:246-268`); marks as `{"type","attrs"}` (`wire/attrs.rs:228-266`). |
| Token unknown → hard failure | Partial | Unknown `type` rejected (`parser.rs:124-148`); unknown mark code `unknown_mark` (`wire/attrs.rs:237-239`) but mapped to generic `invalid-wire` (`problem_map.rs:40-75`). |
| No silent fallback / no unknown-field acceptance | **Divergent** | Block objects ignore unknown fields (`parser.rs:150-151` reads only `type`/`attrs`/`content`); `options` ignored (see above). |
| Deterministic decode/encode, no RNG/clock | Present | No RNG/clock in decode; `sort`-free deterministic writers (`wire/view.rs`, `wire/writer.rs:113-130`). |
| Report uses stable paths `blocks[3].children[1]` | **Divergent** | Paths are dotted indices `0.2.1` (`wire/parser.rs:42-44` `path_string`, doc at `wire/fragment.rs:1-9`); surfaced as `instance` (`problem_map.rs:40-47`). |
| `regenerate` derives from `seed + path + occurrence` | **Missing** | No regeneration code anywhere (grep: only plan/`.knudge` mentions). |

### Plan 12 §4 — batch API, options, report, atomicity

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `Editor.import(batch)` | Present (signature divergent) | `editor.rs:193` returns `String` (never throws); TS types it `ImportReport` (`mod.ts:527-531`). |
| `Editor.dryRun(batch)` for document/fragment/ops | **Missing** | `editor.rs:160-184` + `ops.rs:15-19` parse only `{"ops":[...]}`; an import envelope fails as `malformed_batch`. Plan 12 §4 fourth bullet. |
| `ImportOptions{source,idPolicy,idSeed,addToHistory,requestId,limits}` | **Missing** | `dto.rs:199-236`; no symbol anywhere in `crates/`, `packages/`. |
| `ImportResult{applied, report}` | **Missing** | `import` returns report only; no `changes`/`Applied` (`editor.rs:193-228`, `convert.rs:147-175`). |
| `ImportReport{ok,schema,acceptedBlocks,idMap,requestId}` | **Divergent** | Implemented `{accepted, blocks, version, problems, state}` (`convert.rs:147-175`); TS mirror `mod.ts:264-270`. `blocks` is total block count after apply, not `acceptedBlocks`. |
| `dryRun` validates without transaction | Divergent | It *runs* ops on a clone (creates transactions) (`editor.rs:162-167`). |
| Strict atomicity: nothing changes on rejection | Present | clone/commit (`editor.rs:141-152`, `169-171`, `208-210` for import). |
| Errors = RFC 9457 `ProblemDetails` with type/title/status/detail/instance/code/suggestion | Present | `problem_map.rs:19-37, 192-229`; tests `tests.rs:47-63`. |
| Import failures rejected as `ProblemDetails` | **Divergent** | `import` returns a report with `accepted:false` + `problems` (`editor.rs:193-229`, `import_failure` at `:265-276`); TS never sees a throw. |
| `baseVersion` obligatory for `ops`; `StaleBatch` | Partial | Checked only when present and `mode=="ops"` (`editor.rs:204-211`); absent → silently accepted; ignored for `document`/fragment modes. Code `stale_batch` present (`problem.rs:111-123`). |
| Batch = one transaction, one `GroupId`, one undo | Present | `stage.rs:74` shared `GroupId`; `history.rs:154-166` absorbs same-id groups. |
| `Origin::Import(source)` | **Divergent** | `Origin::Import` is a unit variant, no source (`state/history.rs:25-38`); used at `import.rs:75`, `import.rs:48`; serialized as plain `"import"` (`convert.rs:94-101`). `source` option never parsed. |
| Final `ChangeSet` with `insertedBlocks`/`removedBlocks` + selection | **Divergent** | `ChangeSet` only has coarse `blocks: Range<u32>`, `ranges`, `selection`, `full` (`state/change.rs:29-38`); import returns no ChangeSet at all. |
| `dryRun` returns `ImportReport` **or** `ProblemDetails` | Divergent | Always report JSON (`convert.rs:160-174`); invalid JSON throws malformed_batch. |

### Plan 12 §4 — limits

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `BatchLimits{maxOps,maxBlocks,maxBytes,maxDepth,maxTableCells}` | **Missing** | No DTO/API; only global `Limits` defaults (`lib.rs:44-74`) applied by the parser (`wire/options.rs:5-8`, `ParseOptions::default`). |
| Limit errors code/path (`ImportLimitError`) | Partial | `LimitError` → `limit_exceeded` with `instance:"limits"`, no per-token path (`problem_map.rs:136-138`, `problem.rs:83-93`). |
| `maxOps` cap | **Missing** | `ops.rs:15-19` builds `Vec<Op>` with no count cap; `stage.rs:74-83` loops unbounded. |
| `maxTableCells` cap | **Missing** | `state/table_commands.rs:243-252` only rejects zero/over-u32; no cell count cap. |

### Plan 12 §5 — IDs, refs, media

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `preserve` (keep unique `id`), collision = error | Partial (implicit only) | `id` is the reserved node attr (`schema/spec.rs:132-136`) decoded as ordinary `attrs` (`wire/attrs.rs:55-100`); duplicates detected as invariant `I16` (`model/validate.rs:110-117`) surfaced via `check_doc` (`wire/parser.rs:105-115`) and mapped to code `invalid-wire` with `code:"I16"` (`problem_map.rs:69-75`). |
| `regenerate` + `idMap` | **Missing** | No regeneration/`idMap` symbol in `crates/` or `packages/`. |
| `reject` policy | **Missing** | No policy switch; `StepError::DuplicateId` exists (`error/step.rs:28-31`) and is mapped to `duplicate_id` (`problem_map.rs:100-107`), but **nothing constructs it** (grep shows only definition + mapping) → `duplicate_id` code unreachable. |
| Internal references remapped on regenerate | **Missing** | No ref rewriting; `RefTarget` decode only (`wire/attrs.rs:142-186`). |
| `DocId` not in `Doc`; external refs intact | Present | `DocId` only in `RefTarget` (`model/ids.rs:107-111`); doc attrs have no `doc_id` (`schema/full/attrs.rs:9-20`). |
| `idSeed` + stable path determinism | **Missing** | No seed type/parse. |
| Media attrs `asset_id, src, mime, size_bytes, width, height, intrinsic_*, alt` | Partial | `asset_id/src/alt/width/height/intrinsic_*` present (`schema/full/nodes.rs:173-190`), `alt` required; `size_bytes`/`media_type` only on `attachment` (`nodes.rs:234-242`); **no `mime` on image/video/audio**. |
| Reject `data:` / raw HTML | **Missing** | `src`/`srcset` are plain `Str` with no validation (grep `data:` → none in `crates/`). |
| `missing_asset` code | **Missing** | Not emitted anywhere (`problem.rs`/`problem_map.rs` grep). |
| `unrepresentable_feature` code | **Missing** | Not emitted; unknown kinds produce `unknown_token` (`problem_map.rs:40-75`). |

### Plan 11 §3 — WASM surface (DocView/block/view/transaction/composition)

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `view(range?: BlockRange): DocView` | Divergent | `viewJSON()` takes no range (`wasm/src/editor/view.rs:16-20`); TS `view()` no args (`mod.ts:556-558`); core `view_json` writes whole doc (`wire/view.rs:48-52`). |
| `block(index): BlockView | null` | **Missing** | Not in `wasm/rich_editor_auy_wasm.d.ts:1-118`. |
| `selection()` / `setSelection(selection)` | Divergent | Only `setSelection(from,to)` (`editor.rs:243-256`); selection readable only through `stateJSON` (`convert.rs:105-110`). |
| `toJSON(): string` (canonical doc) | Divergent | WASM has `docJSON` (`editor.rs:94-99`); TS `toJSON()` returns `EditorStateJSON` (`mod.ts:551-554`). |
| `a11yTree()`, `validate()`, `validateA11y()` on Editor | Partial | `a11yTree` only via `Document` round-trip (`mod.ts:591-593`); `validate()` absent; `validateA11y` only on `Document` (`mod.ts:435-438`). |
| `canUndo/canRedo/history/clearHistory` | Partial | `historyJSON`, `clearHistory` present (`editor.rs:120-128`, `258-261`); no `canUndo`/`canRedo` methods (flags only, `convert.rs:58-67`). |
| `Transaction` class (§3.2) incl. table ops `insertTable/insertRow/...` | **Missing** | No transaction binding in WASM; core table commands live on `Editor` (`state/table_commands.rs:18-143`), not `Transaction`; `slice`/`insertSlice` also absent. |
| `beginComposition/updateComposition/commitComposition/cancelComposition` | **Missing** | Core has them (`state/composition.rs:77-249`); no DTO, op, or binding in WASM (grep of `crates/rich-editor-auy-wasm` and `packages/ts` finds no composition API). |
| Composition as single history entry / cancel restores | Present in core, unreachable at boundary | `state/composition.rs:169-172`, `245-249`; no WASM path. |
| Errors structured `{code,message,path?,offset?}` never opaque strings | Divergent | Structured RFC 9457 objects, but `detail`/`instance` only; `offset` is embedded in detail text (`problem_map.rs:58-66`), not a field; `DocumentError` exposes `code/status/detail/instance/suggestion` (`mod.ts:369-391`). |

### Plan 11 §9 acceptance criteria

| # | Criterion | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | no public path uses `Schema::basic()`/custom schema | Present | All boundary paths use `Schema::full()` (`editor.rs:35-39`, `lib.rs:60-64`); `Schema::basic()` only in tests/testkit (`crates/rich-editor-auy/tests/**`, `rich-editor-auy-testkit/src/lib.rs:41`). |
| 3 | DocView carries image dims/`src`, list `start`, metadata, table attrs, IDs, marks with attrs | Present | `wire/view.rs:60-100` writes ids, schema-ordered attrs (covers `asset_id/width/height/intrinsic_*`, list `start`, table attrs), doc attrs incl. `metadata` (`view.rs:33-38`), mark attrs (`wire/writer.rs:186-206`). |
| 4 | ChangeSet allows updating specific blocks; Applied doesn't return whole document | Divergent | `ChangeSet.blocks` is a single coarse range + `full` flag (`state/change.rs:29-38`); no inserted/removed block lists. WASM additionally **does** copy the whole document in every result (`applied_json`, `convert.rs:113-121`; `state_json`), contradicting "Applied não carrega o documento inteiro". |

## Exact gaps (actionable, ordered)

1. **`ImportOptions` is dropped silently** — add to `dto.rs:199-236` with `organization` `source/idPolicy/idSeed/addToHistory/requestId/limits`, and `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]` on `BatchPayload`/`ImportPayload`/`ImportDocument`-like structs; wire into `editor.rs:193-229`.
2. **No ID engine**: implement `preserve/regenerate/reject`, `idSeed` path derivation (`seed + path + occurrence`), internal `RefTarget` remap, and `idMap` (`BTreeMap`) in `ImportReport`. Duplicate-ID path currently yields code `I16` (`model/validate.rs:110-117` → `problem_map.rs:69-75`), while `duplicate_id` at `problem_map.rs:100-107` is unreachable.
3. **Token vocabulary mismatch**: `wire/fragment.rs` reads only `blocks`; `wire/parser.rs` expects Doc JSON `type/content`, not plan `BlockToken{kind,runs,atoms,children}`. Either add a real fragment token decoder or update plan/TS. `openStart/openEnd` are silently ignored (`open_start/open_end` exist only in `step/mod.rs:38-41`).
4. **Missing batch ops**: `insertTable`, `setMetadata`, and plan-named `replaceRange`/`insertFragment` are absent (`dto.rs:68-190`). `insertTable` needs core table commands moved/added to `Transaction` (`state/table_commands.rs` is `impl Editor`).
5. **`ImportReport` shape and failure semantics**: change to `{ok,schema,acceptedBlocks,idMap,requestId}` (plus `applied`), make `import` reject with `ProblemDetails`, and have `dryRun` accept the three import envelopes (`editor.rs:160-229`, `convert.rs:147-175`, TS `mod.ts:264-270`).
6. **`dryRun` accepts only `{"ops":…}`** (`ops.rs:15-19`); plan requires document/fragment/ops.
7. **`baseVersion` is optional and only checked for `ops`** (`editor.rs:204-211`); make it required for `ops` and enforce equality for other modes if used.
8. **`Origin::Import(source)` unimplementable** — `Origin::Import` is a unit variant (`state/history.rs:25-38`); add source payload and echo it (or drop requirement).
9. **`addToHistory:false` impossible** — `run_ops` never calls `set_add_to_history` (`stage.rs:74-83`); `apply_replacement` likewise (`import.rs:73-83`).
10. **No `BatchLimits` / caps**: no `maxOps` check (`stage.rs:74`), no `maxBlocks/bytes/maxTableCells` per-batch (`dto.rs`, `ops.rs`); only global `Limits` defaults (`lib.rs:44-74`).
11. **`missing_asset` and `unrepresentable_feature` never emitted**; `unknown_mark` falls through to `invalid-wire` (`wire/attrs.rs:237-239` → `problem_map.rs:75`), and `unknown_attr` detail uses the *path* as the attribute name (`problem_map.rs:52` → `attr_problem(instance, instance)`).
12. **Stable-path format divergence**: dotted `0.2.1` (`wire/parser.rs:42-44`) vs plan `blocks[3].children[1]`.
13. **Composition, `Transaction`, `block(index)`, `view(range)`, `slice/insertSlice`, `setNodeId`** absent from WASM/TS (`wasm/rich_editor_auy_wasm.d.ts:1-118`, `mod.ts:494-598`); core supports them (`state/composition.rs`, `state/transaction.rs:200-212`).
14. **`DocView` lacks range-scoped materialization** (`editor/view.rs:16-20`) and Applied/report copies the full document (`convert.rs:105-121`), contrary to plan 11 §3.3.
15. **Media validation gaps**: no `mime` on image/video/audio (`schema/full/nodes.rs:173-242`), no `data:`/raw-HTML rejection, `size_bytes` only on attachment.

## Tests that would need extending (evidence of coverage gaps)

- `crates/rich-editor-auy-wasm/src/tests.rs:1-113` covers DTO/op-name/problem/attr decoding only — no import-mode, ID, limit, or atomicity tests at Rust level.
- `packages/ts/packages/core/mod_test.ts:83-135` covers document/insert-fragment/unknown-token/stale only — no `options`, `idPolicy`, `idMap`, `acceptedBlocks`, `requestId`, `addToHistory`, `insertTable`, `setMetadata`, fragment `openStart/openEnd`, or composition.

## verificação
crates/rich-editor-auy-wasm/src/tests.rs:1-113 covers DTO/op-name/problem/attr decoding only — no import-mode, ID, limit, or atomicity tests at Rust level.

## verificação
packages/ts/packages/core/mod_test.ts:83-135 covers document/insert-fragment/unknown-token/stale only — no options, idPolicy, idMap, acceptedBlocks, requestId, addToHistory, insertTable, setMetadata, fragment openStart/openEnd, or composition.
